title: "Ask Aaron"
description: "A retrieval-augmented assistant that answers questions about my work, research and projects."
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

Ask about my work history, research, data engineering projects or skills.
The assistant retrieves from a curated knowledge base of my CV, publications
and project documentation, routes each question to the right collection and
answers with citations from the retrieved material.

```{=html}
<style>
  #ask-wrap { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 900px; }
  #ask-wrap iframe { width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; }
  #ask-loading {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.75rem;
    background: #fff; border: 1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius: 0.5rem;
    color: #495057; text-align: center; padding: 1rem;
  }
  #ask-loading.hidden { display: none; }
  #ask-spinner {
    width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; border-radius: 50%;
    border: 4px solid #dee2e6; border-top-color: #0d6efd;
    animation: ask-spin 0.9s linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes ask-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
  #ask-loading small { color: #6c757d; }
</style>
<div id="ask-wrap">
  <div id="ask-loading" role="status" aria-live="polite">
    <div id="ask-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></div>
    <div><strong>Starting the assistant</strong></div>
    <div>The first load can take up to a minute while the server wakes up. Waiting <span id="ask-seconds">0</span> s…</div>
    <small>Once it is running, answers take a few seconds.</small>
  </div>
  <iframe
    id="ask-frame"
    src="https://ask-aaron-201418184721.europe-west3.run.app/"
    title="Ask Aaron - RAG assistant">
  </iframe>
</div>
<script>
  (function () {
    var overlay = document.getElementById("ask-loading");
    var counter = document.getElementById("ask-seconds");
    var frame = document.getElementById("ask-frame");
    var start = Date.now();
    var timer = setInterval(function () {
      counter.textContent = Math.round((Date.now() - start) / 1000);
    }, 1000);
    function done() {
      clearInterval(timer);
      overlay.classList.add("hidden");
    }
    frame.addEventListener("load", done);
    // Safety net: never leave the overlay up forever.
    setTimeout(done, 120000);
  })();
</script>
```

If the embedded app does not load,
[open it in its own tab](https://ask-aaron-201418184721.europe-west3.run.app/){target="_blank"}.

## How it works

Questions are classified into one of three routes (work history, my own
research, or the related literature), each backed by its own vector
collection. Retrieved chunks are shown alongside every answer — tick "Show
retrieved chunks" to see the passages it read and which route it took. The
pipeline is Python, ChromaDB and Claude, deployed on Google Cloud Run.
